messages:
maria: Quick RFC follow-up — re: slicing the runtime into 'antifragile slices' to reduce blast radius. High-level proposal in doc: https://internal.redwood/g/antifragile-slices
maria: TL;DR: split inference-serving into three vertical slices: frontdoor (routing + auth), execution (runtime + kernels), and cache-control (kv cache & prefix store). Each slice owns its contracts, health, and scaling.
sam: +1 on ownership, but curious about cross-slice transactionality — e.g., cache invalidation on model rollouts?
jordan: We discussed a hook-based invalidation earlier. Idea: execution emits model-version events, cache-control subscribes and does per-prefix invalidation. Minimal sync.
alex: Concern: left-shift testing. If slices have independent deploys, how to run integration tests fast? Suggestion: lightweight 'slice-emulator' harness in CI to run local orchestration.
maria: Agree. Want canary strategy: when execution releases new quantized kernels, route 1% traffic to new slice via router feature-flag.
sam: Also: metric ownership. frontend should not emit infra-level p99s for execution — execution owns latency SLIs, frontend owns end-to-end latency.
jordan: Implementation note: keep RPC surface minimal: only /infer, /health, /meta. No rich SCM-related endpoints.
alex: Example config snippet for router policy:
```
route_policy:
  - model_groups: ["gpt-small","gpt-medium"]
    target: execution-v2
    fallback: execution-v1
    weight: 0.01
```

maria: Ops question: tech debt paydown schedule — propose 3 quarters: Q1 split ownership + tests, Q2 rollouts + canaries, Q3 deprecate monolith endpoints.
sam: +1. Can we add a debt scorecard in console per slice? helps prioritization.
jordan: I'll prototype a "slice-debt" dashboard: lists endpoints, test coverage, incident count.
maria: Sounds good. Next steps: jordan to prototype dashboard, alex to draft CI harness, sam to enumerate SLO boundaries. I'll update the RFC and ping infra for networking isolation.
maria: tagging @eng-sre FYI :eyes: \neng-sre-bot: Notifying channel eng-sre about network isolation request.
maria: thanks, closing thread for now — will post updated RFC link when ready :tada:
